topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Oh wow, I just got these beautiful flowers and there's no card! Isn't that the sweetest, most mysterious thing? I mean, can you imagine someone thinking of me like that, knowing just what I'd love, but deciding to keep it a secret? It’s like having a little treasure hunt, only the treasure is this amazing bouquet right here. Who could it be, right? Maybe it’s time to start making some guesses and maybe, just maybe, finding a way to thank this mystery person. But hey, even if we never find out, it’s such a lovely surprise, don’t you think? Makes you wonder who’s out there, thinking of you in the nicest way.
